notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning either Dualcaster Mage or any other nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, targeting Jeska's Will.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, creating a copy of Jeska's Will.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
